subject: Commitment rationalization and cloud invoice routing
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Harmonia Health <procurement@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Rep <aws-pp@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commitment rationalization and cloud invoice routing

Hi all —

Following our executive touchpoint last week, Harmonia is ready to move forward with a consolidated commitment but has two asks that we need to align on before legal/finance will sign: 1) they want a single PO that covers committed spend across AWS and GCP marketplace listings, and 2) they require that invoices for each cloud be routed to their finance system (HelixCloud Finance) with explicit invoice metadata for ledger mapping (region, marketplace id, SKU).

To keep the procurement cycle short, proposed plan:
- We provide a consolidated PO template that lists per-cloud subledgers (line items mapped to marketplace IDs).
- Redwood issues cloud-specific invoices (one per marketplace) that include a reference field: "RW_DEAL=RW-2027-1934" and Harmonia's internal ledger code in the invoice metadata.
- AWS/GCP marketplace onboarding teams confirm the Private Offer IDs and whether a single DocuSign bundle can cover both marketplace terms.

Action requested: Kimberly/ Priyom — can you review the attached invoice_mapping_ledger.xlsx and the PO draft and confirm: (a) whether our billing system can inject the RW_DEAL and taxonomy fields per-invoice, and (b) whether you'll need a separate accounting contact for EU VAT handling if Harmonia signals EMEA usage?

Harmonia — would appreciate a short reply with the exact pay-to entity and the email for HelixCloud Finance so we can put the correct routing on the draft.

Attachments: Harmonia_PO_Draft_v3.pdf, invoice_mapping_ledger.xlsx

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Harmonia Health <procurement@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Rep <aws-pp@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commitment rationalization and cloud invoice routing

Jordan — quick notes after a brief review with legal and billing ops:

1) Billing system: we can surface a custom metadata block on outbound invoices (fields: RW_DEAL, marketplace_id, region, external_ledger_code). Priyom will confirm the exact export column order for the accounting ERP.

2) DocuSign / PO bundling: Legal prefers separate acceptance language per marketplace because of differing marketplace TOS. That said, we can prepare a single PO (master) that references two marketplace-specific appendices. That lets procurement sign once while preserving marketplace-specific clauses.

3) Tax considerations: if Harmonia reports EMEA usage under a different VAT entity, we'll need their VAT registration number and the pay-to entity for cross-border invoices. If the pay-to is the same, we can include an EU VAT appendix; otherwise, we need a second legal signatory.

I've attached a redline suggestion for the PO and flagged where marketplace-specific language should be. Priyom — can you confirm whether our outbound invoice system can send invoices to an external SFTP endpoint (HelixCloud Finance) as an alternate routing? That would speed reconciliation on their side.

Attachments: Harmonia_PO_Draft_v3_redline.pdf

Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

---

From: Harmonia Procurement <procurement@harmoniahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelixCloud Finance <finance@helixcloud.io>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment rationalization and cloud invoice routing

Thanks Jordan/Kimberly — appreciate the thoroughness. A few clarifications from procurement:

1) Pay-to entity: Harmonia Health Services, Inc. (EIN: 47-8893334). Please route invoices to accounts.payable@harmoniahealth.com, and copy finance@helixcloud.io.

2) HelixCloud Finance has confirmed they can accept an SFTP drop for inbound invoices; credentials and a folder path will be provided once we sign. In the meantime, please include the following fields on each invoice: RW_DEAL, external_ledger_code (we will provide codes), marketplace_id, and cost_center.

3) DocuSign: procurement prefers a single-signature flow if possible. If Redwood can produce a master PO that references marketplace appendices, procurement will sign the master and treat the appendices as exhibit attachments on our side. That aligns with our internal PO processing.

Next steps from our side: we will provide the external_ledger_code list and an SFTP contact by Wednesday. Please confirm whether Redwood can emit cloud-specific invoice numbers (e.g., RW-AWS-####, RW-GCP-####) so our AP team can reconcile per-cloud spend.

Best,
Camila Reyes (on behalf of Harmonia Procurement)
Harmonia Health
procurement@harmoniahealth.com

---

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Harmonia Procurement <procurement@harmoniahealth.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Partner Rep <aws-pp@amazon.com>, HelixCloud Finance <finance@helixcloud.io>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commitment rationalization and cloud invoice routing

Thanks Camila — this is helpful. Quick confirmation and action items so we can close the PO next week:

Action items (Redwood):
- Priyom: confirm SFTP drop support and the ERP export column order by EOD Thu (we need to ensure our invoice metadata maps to Harmonia's ledger codes).
- Kimberly: finish final redline of master PO with two appendix exhibits and share with us for signature-ready DocuSign bundle.
- Ops: we will produce cloud-specific invoice numbers (format: RW-AWS-YYYY-####, RW-GCP-YYYY-####) as requested.

Action items (Harmonia):
- Provide external_ledger_code list and SFTP contact (HelixCloud) — target Wed.
- Confirm whether one signature on the master PO is sufficient (procurement indicated yes).

AWS Partner Rep — can you confirm whether the AWS Private Offer ID included here (attached in redwood-private-offer-ids.txt) is sufficient for the marketplace team to tie the private offer to a master PO? If there are any additional marketplace-side steps (acceptance windows, listing synchronization), please flag them so we can surface to Harmonia.

I'll assemble a single DocuSign packet that contains the master PO and two appendices, and will drop the packet into the HubSpot deal record (link included above) once Kimberly confirms the redline.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Sr. Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-private-offer-ids.txt
